verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own IT-automation docs state that admins can perform bulk operations across users, devices, and groups through its APIs or its first-party PowerShell module. The RESTful API also covers directory, device, and onboarding/offboarding operations, and an official support repo provides scripts and API examples. Missing for 10: detailed reference docs for specific bulk endpoints or cmdlets (batch limits, error handling), and independent hands-on corroboration that bulk operations work at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Through APIs or our PowerShell module, operate at scale by performing bulk operations across users, devices, and groups
establish automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows, and manage and export your directory events data through RESTful commands
provide helpful scripts that complement various JumpCloud services including API examples
